Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.

Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 18-10-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Central University of Rajasthan (CURAJ) for filling up temporary research positions under an ICMR-funded project based in Bandarsindri, Ajmer, Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by CURAJ?
faq.answer: CURAJ has advertised for the post of Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) under advertisement number IIRPSG-2025-01-00081 for eligible and qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post in this recruitment drive issued by the Central University of Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for CURAJ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email to the principal investigator is 18 October 2026. Candidates must ensure they submit before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their filled application form along with self-attested documents to the designated email address of the principal investigator.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First class or Second class M.Pharm, M.S.(Pharm.), M.Tech(Pharm), M.Sc.(Life Sciences), or M.Tech degree with GATE, GPAT, CSIR-NET, UGC-NET, or a PhD in relevant fields.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) position is 35 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 56,000/- per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) of 10% amounting to Rs. 5,600 per month.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for CURAJ Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the initial shortlisting of received applications followed by an interview process for the shortlisted eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and website?
faq.answer: You can check the official notification details and visit the official website at www.curaj.ac.in to get all authentic updates regarding the recruitment drive.
